tokens.name: paper-0
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pure white: evidence frame mats and report pages.

tokens.name: paper-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Archival paper white, faintly green-grey: the page ground in Paper.

tokens.name: paper-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Sunken wells, zebra rows, quiet chips.

tokens.name: paper-200
tokens.usage: Primitive. Hairline rules on paper.

tokens.name: paper-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Stronger rules and dividers on paper. Decorative only, never a control border.

tokens.name: stone-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Tertiary text and control borders on paper (4.5:1 on paper-50, paper-100 and white).

tokens.name: stone-600
tokens.usage: Primitive. Secondary text on paper.

tokens.name: ink-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pressed state of ink fills.

tokens.name: ink-800
tokens.usage: Primitive. Hover state of ink fills.

tokens.name: ink-900
tokens.usage: Primitive. Iron-gall ink: body text and primary buttons in Paper.

tokens.name: ink-950
tokens.usage: Primitive. The page ground in Ink.

tokens.name: rubric-400
tokens.usage: Primitive. The rubric red, lifted for dark grounds.

tokens.name: rubric-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. The rubric red: the mark that means recorded.

tokens.name: rubric-600
tokens.usage: Primitive. The rubric red dark enough for text on paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page ground behind everything.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, the review card, evidence frame mats, sheets.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells behind frame strips, zebra rows in long tables, read-only fields.

tokens.name: surface-inverse
tokens.usage: Primary buttons and toasts: the one solid fill on a screen.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and values on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Labels, captions and provenance on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, timestamps and disabled text on surface and surface-raised. Never for anything a reader must act on.

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Text on surface-inverse.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairline between ledger rows and inside tables.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Section dividers and table heads. Decorative: never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, secondary buttons and checkboxes (3:1 or more on every surface).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px keyboard focus outline, offset 2px, on every interactive element.

tokens.name: rubric
tokens.usage: The mark that means recorded: the full stop in the wordmark, the approval stroke on a line number, the hallmark dot. Never a button fill, never decoration.

tokens.name: rubric-text
tokens.usage: Rubric red when it has to be text, on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: not-seen-mark
tokens.usage: Icon and dot. Not seen on this walk: a question, not an accusation (DMS-063). Dashed-circle icon.

tokens.name: not-seen-text
tokens.usage: Chip label on not-seen-tint. Not seen on this walk: a question, not an accusation (DMS-063). Dashed-circle icon.

tokens.name: not-seen-tint
tokens.usage: Chip ground. Not seen on this walk: a question, not an accusation (DMS-063). Dashed-circle icon.

tokens.name: moved-mark
tokens.usage: Icon and dot. Moved to another room, or found elsewhere against the books. Arrow icon.

tokens.name: moved-text
tokens.usage: Chip label on moved-tint. Moved to another room, or found elsewhere against the books. Arrow icon.

tokens.name: moved-tint
tokens.usage: Chip ground. Moved to another room, or found elsewhere against the books. Arrow icon.

tokens.name: new-mark
tokens.usage: Icon and dot. New since the last walk, or unrecorded in the books. Plus icon.

tokens.name: new-text
tokens.usage: Chip label on new-tint. New since the last walk, or unrecorded in the books. Plus icon.

tokens.name: new-tint
tokens.usage: Chip ground. New since the last walk, or unrecorded in the books. Plus icon.

tokens.name: worse-mark
tokens.usage: Icon and dot. Condition worse than the last walk. Down-chevron icon.

tokens.name: worse-text
tokens.usage: Chip label on worse-tint. Condition worse than the last walk. Down-chevron icon.

tokens.name: worse-tint
tokens.usage: Chip ground. Condition worse than the last walk. Down-chevron icon.

tokens.name: better-mark
tokens.usage: Icon and dot. Condition better than the last walk. Up-chevron icon.

tokens.name: better-text
tokens.usage: Chip label on better-tint. Condition better than the last walk. Up-chevron icon.

tokens.name: better-tint
tokens.usage: Chip ground. Condition better than the last walk. Up-chevron icon.

tokens.name: unsafe-mark
tokens.usage: Icon and dot. Not working or unsafe, and safety findings. The only red that means danger. Triangle icon.

tokens.name: unsafe-text
tokens.usage: Chip label on unsafe-tint. Not working or unsafe, and safety findings. The only red that means danger. Triangle icon.

tokens.name: unsafe-tint
tokens.usage: Chip ground. Not working or unsafe, and safety findings. The only red that means danger. Triangle icon.

tokens.name: not-filmed-mark
tokens.usage: Icon and dot. Room not filmed: no claim is made about its assets (DMS-071). Hatched-square icon.

tokens.name: not-filmed-text
tokens.usage: Chip label on not-filmed-tint. Room not filmed: no claim is made about its assets (DMS-071). Hatched-square icon.

tokens.name: not-filmed-tint
tokens.usage: Chip ground. Room not filmed: no claim is made about its assets (DMS-071). Hatched-square icon.

tokens.name: confirmed-mark
tokens.usage: Icon and dot. Found, unchanged or approved. Ink, not green: the normal state needs no colour. Tick icon.

tokens.name: confirmed-text
tokens.usage: Chip label on confirmed-tint. Found, unchanged or approved. Ink, not green: the normal state needs no colour. Tick icon.

tokens.name: confirmed-tint
tokens.usage: Chip ground. Found, unchanged or approved. Ink, not green: the normal state needs no colour. Tick icon.

tokens.name: camera-scrim
tokens.usage: Behind every control laid over the live camera. Same in both themes: the camera is always dark.

tokens.name: camera-text
tokens.usage: Text and icons over camera-scrim. Same in both themes: the camera is always dark.

tokens.name: camera-text-secondary
tokens.usage: Timers, sizes and secondary labels over camera-scrim. Same in both themes: the camera is always dark.

tokens.name: camera-record
tokens.usage: The recording light and the stop button's core. Required by DMS-103. Same in both themes: the camera is always dark.

tokens.name: camera-chip
tokens.usage: Live guidance pills (Slow down, Too dark) over the camera. Same in both themes: the camera is always dark.

tokens.name: camera-chip-text
tokens.usage: Text on camera-chip. Same in both themes: the camera is always dark.

tokens.name: camera-coverage-done
tokens.usage: Faced segments of the coverage dial. Same in both themes: the camera is always dark.

tokens.name: camera-coverage-todo
tokens.usage: Segments of the coverage dial not yet faced. Same in both themes: the camera is always dark.

tokens.name: camera-tick
tokens.usage: Corner ticks around a detected item on the live view and on frames. Same in both themes: the camera is always dark.

tokens.name: button-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button fill.

tokens.name: button-primary-text
tokens.usage: Primary button label.

tokens.name: frame-mat
tokens.usage: Behind an evidence frame while it loads and around letterboxed frames.

tokens.name: frame-tick-halo
tokens.usage: Shadow under camera-tick so ticks read on bright walls.

tokens.name: approval-stroke
tokens.usage: The rubric stroke across an approved line's number.

tokens.name: row-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill for ledger rows and room rows.

tokens.name: row-selected
tokens.usage: The line under review, and selected rows before a bulk action.

styles.name: ui-title-m

styles.usage: Field labels and eyebrows, always set in capitals.

styles.name: ui-capture

styles.name: data-s
